content:
maria_cs: Quick pulse on Frontera account — weekly consumption sprint. Looking at WoW + QoQ token usage and throughput. CC @jake_se
jake_se: Quick numbers from ingestion dashboard: tokens WoW +12%, QoQ +38%. Avg throughput up 9% WoW but tail latency (p90) rose 210ms -> 240ms. Error rate bumped 0.2% -> 0.35% (spike Tue 03:12 UTC). Spend +9% WoW.
sofia_sre: I saw pod CPU queueing on pod-2 during that Tue spike; autoscaler didn't add nodes until 85% util. Traces show backpressure and some retry storms. Adding trace: https://observability.redwood/frontera/trace/abc123
maria_cs: Context — customer enabled higher-concurrency ingest batch and flipped streaming on Monday without batching config we recommended.
jake_se: They moved to model variant model-redwood/gpt-medium-quant to save cost; quantization reduced per-token cost but throughput per-GPU dropped ~18% vs previous model. That explains tradeoffs.
oliver_re: I'll draft a short playbook: recommended batch_size, prefetch, model variant tradeoffs, and cost estimates. Also propose a quick enablement call.
maria_cs: Renewal health still green but flagging this as a near-term churn risk if spend keeps spiking and latency persists. Suggested outreach: enablement Thurs 10am PT.
sofia_sre: Deployed autoscaler tweak in staging: lowered scale_down_delay to 30s and added queue_depth custom metric to trigger scale-up earlier.
deploy-bot: deployment succeeded: autoscaler-config v2 -> staging at 2445006885
jake_se: Ran synthetic load after change — staging median latency 195ms, throughput +14% compared to baseline. Tail improved modestly.
maria_cs: Great. Oliver, can you produce a customer-facing note explaining the config change, expected cost delta, and step-by-step instructions? We want something they can action before the call.
oliver_re: On it. I’ll send a templated note + one-pager with screenshots and a short checklist.
maria_cs: Action items: oliver send note by EOD Wed; jake to wire up an ingest-level dashboard with per-model throughput and token burn; sofia to schedule prod rollout after 24h stable staging.
sofia_sre: Will monitor staging for 24h and post rollout plan here.
maria_cs: Thanks team. Next check-in next Tue. :thumbsup:
